_real_world.role: Beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile, primary long-range weapon for F/A-18E/F Block III, EA-18G, F-35C
_real_world.range_nmi: Classified (Navy explicitly classifies both range and speed per NAVAIR)
_real_world.guidance_real: Inertial midcourse + launch-aircraft datalink; active radar terminal homing; home-on-jam capability (an improvement over the AIM-120C-7's guidance suite)
_real_world.speed: Classified (repo AIM-120C-7 template's Mach ~4/1372 m/s used as the closest sourced same-family anchor)
_real_world.mount_mapping: referenced by CVW-8 aircraft default_loadout as an air-to-air weapon; no distinct AIM-120D vs AIM-120C-7 mechanism differentiation exists in the engine beyond the Missile record's own flight_model/guidance/warhead fields

mass_kg.note: 358 lb = 162.4 kg per CSG order-of-battle page's NAVAIR-sourced AIM-120D row

max_flight_time_s.note: no public range/speed figure (Navy explicitly classifies both per the OOB page); proxy close to the repo AIM-120C-7 template's 45.0 s, nudged slightly up reflecting AIM-120D's publicly-claimed range improvement over the -C7 without a quantified figure

flight_model.max_speed.note: classified; proxy copied unchanged from the repo AIM-120C-7 template (weapons/air_to_air/aim_120c.json) as the closest same-family sourced anchor

guidance.capture_guidance_mode.note: disabled: no terminal capture-guidance submode modeled beyond the base active-radar terminal phase

guidance.target_tracker_beta.note: standard tracker filter constant, same basis as target_tracker_alpha

modeling_notes: Functional mount via standard air-launched missile mechanism (no CSG-specific mechanism gap for air-to-air weapons, unlike naval anti-ship/torpedo types). Range and speed are explicitly classified by the Navy per the OOB page; the repo AIM-120C-7 template is used as the same-family sourced anchor for all unclassified-adjacent flight/guidance scaffold fields.
